instructions.content: NEVER hardcode model IDs without verifying availability first; GitHub Copilot access varies by subscription tier and region, so a hardcoded ID can fail silently.
NEVER rely on OpenCode's model registry alone; it is a release-time snapshot and does not track live per-account policy changes.
NEVER ignore `policy.state` when selecting a model; `disabled` or `preview` models can appear in a listing yet still reject requests at runtime.
NEVER assume context window size from a model's name; check `capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens` explicitly.
NEVER treat a `preview` model as production-safe; preview access can be restricted or withdrawn without the standard deprecation notice a stable model would get.
Query models via `fetch-models.sh` (or an equivalent direct GitHub Copilot API call) rather than trusting OpenCode's bundled registry.
Filter for `policy.state == "enabled"` before selecting a model for unattended or production use.
Check the `capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens` field explicitly rather than guessing context size from the model name.
Check the `capabilities.supports.vision` field explicitly when a task requires image/vision input, rather than inferring it from the model name or vendor.
Test a newly selected model with a per-command validation call before setting it as the project default.
Use per-command model selection while testing; only set a project default after the model has been validated as stable.
